class.name: ViewHolder
class.brief_description: Wraps the Control that displays a single item.
class.description: ViewHolder is the port of [i]RecyclerView.ViewHolder[/i]: a lightweight object that wraps the Control displaying one item. It is created by [method Adapter._create_item], bound by [method Adapter._bind_item], and recycled when its position scrolls out of view. The [method get_control] / [method set_control] pair manages the underlying Control; the [code]get_position[/code] / [code]get_item_view_type[/code] accessors report the holder's current adapter position and view type.

method.name: add_flags
method.description: Adds the given flag bits.

method.name: clear_old_position
method.description: Clears the saved old and pre-layout positions.

method.name: flag_removed_and_offset_position
method.description: Marks the holder removed and shifts its position (used during remove animations).

method.name: get_flags
method.description: Returns the full flag bitmask.

method.name: get_item_view_type
method.description: Returns the view type of this holder.

method.name: get_layout_position
method.description: Returns the layout position, preferring the pre-layout position when one exists.

method.name: get_old_position
method.description: Returns the old position saved before an update.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the current adapter position.

method.name: get_stable_id
method.description: Returns the stable id of this holder, or -1 when none is set.

method.name: is_adapter_position_unknown
method.description: Returns whether the holder has the [constant FLAG_ADAPTER_POSITION_UNKNOWN] flag.

method.name: is_bound
method.description: Returns whether the holder has the [constant FLAG_BOUND] flag.

method.name: is_invalid
method.description: Returns whether the holder has the [constant FLAG_INVALID] flag.

method.name: is_recyclable
method.description: Returns whether the holder may be recycled.

method.name: is_removed
method.description: Returns whether the holder's data has been removed.

method.name: is_tmp_detached
method.description: Returns whether the holder has the [constant FLAG_TMP_DETACHED] flag.

method.name: is_updated
method.description: Returns whether the holder has the [constant FLAG_UPDATE] flag.

method.name: offset_position
method.description: Shifts the holder's position by [code]offset[/code], recording old / pre-layout positions.

method.name: reset_internal
method.description: Resets internal state when the holder is recycled.

method.name: save_old_position
method.description: Stores the current position as the old position.

method.name: set_flags
method.description: Sets or clears the given flag bits according to [code]mask[/code].

method.name: set_is_recyclable
method.description: Increases/decreases the recyclable count and sets or clears [constant FLAG_NOT_RECYCLABLE].

method.name: set_item_view_type
method.description: Sets the view type of this holder.

method.name: set_position
method.description: Sets the adapter position.

method.name: set_stable_id
method.description: Sets the stable id of this holder.

method.name: should_ignore
method.description: Returns whether the holder has the [constant FLAG_IGNORE] flag (layout / animation should skip it).

members.member: The root Control that displays the item.
